title: Safety-net plan and internal CA
detail: I decided to back up off the production host, set a snapshot-before-change rule, and stood up a private certificate authority.

title: Lab audit and agent boundaries
detail: A full audit produced the renumbering plan, and I set the rule that the IT-assistant agent never gets root SSH.

title: Renumbering and default-deny firewall
detail: Every guest moved to the ID-to-address scheme, one guest migrated from container to VM, and the firewall went default-deny.

title: Backup disk-full bug found
detail: Orphaned backups from the old IDs filled the host disk and failed nightly jobs, which led to a documented cleanup procedure.

title: Claude Code joins as lab admin
detail: flynn arrived in its own container, driven through Remote Control, sharing the Obsidian vault with the other agent.

title: Restore testing automated
detail: A restore-tester subagent now proves backups boot by restoring them into an isolated scratch ID and tearing them down.

title: Orchestrator model for agents
detail: The main agent plans and reviews while cheaper subagents do the legwork, with an auditor checking each change.

title: Nightly vault and config backup
detail: A job pushes the vault history and sanitized configs to my Git server, blocked automatically by a secret scanner.

title: Internal CA fix for phones
detail: A phone failing over Tailscale turned out to lack the root certificate, so I documented a CA install runbook.

title: Local dictation on the GPU
detail: Dictation apps on my laptop and PC now clean up transcripts through the local model server.

title: This showcase
detail: I decided to publish Heisenberg Lab, a sanitized public view of the lab, with the sandbox VM shown only as top secret.
